page_title: AUX 2-2 LEN | Auxerre v Lens 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Jeremy Stinat is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Lens are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
90+2' Here is a change. Gaetan Perrin is going off and Christophe Pelissier gives the last tactical orders to Florian Aye (Auxerre).
90+1' The linesman signals that David Pereira da Costa (Lens) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Adrien Thomasson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Hamzat Ojediran (Lens).

89' Florian Sotoca (Lens) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
88' Deiver Machado (Lens) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Lens will take a throw-in.
86' Lens seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
86' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.

81' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The referee points to the corner flag and Lens will take a corner.
81' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre) replacing Elisha Owusu.
81' Remy Labeau Lascary is substituted due to injury. Will Still gives a chance to Florian Sotoca (Lens).
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Deiver Machado (Lens) coming on for Anass Zaroury.
80' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

76' Auxerre slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
73' 2 - 2 Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) jumps for a cross and plants a precise header low inside the left post.
73' Auxerre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Angelo Fulgini leaves the pitch and David Pereira da Costa (Lens) comes on.
69' We are about to witness a substitution. Andy Diouf (Lens) is replacing Neil El Aynaoui.

67' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lens are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
65' NO PENALTY! Referee Jeremy Stinat has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Auxerre players are incensed.
65' Christophe Pelissier has decided to substitute Ado Onaiwu and he is replaced by Theo Bair (Auxerre).
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) will replace Paul Joly.
64' Paul Joly (Auxerre) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
64' Celebrations by Auxerre are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

62' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul. PENALTY to Auxerre! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
62' Auxerre keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
60' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre), whose effort would probably have ended inside the bottom left corner of the net.

59' Lens slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
56' A quickly taken corner by Auxerre.

54' Anass Zaroury (Lens) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Donovan Leon was ready and made a save.
52' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
52' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
51' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
50' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
49' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
48' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) produces a mid-range free kick and sends a daisy-cutter towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a good save and stops his effort.
46' Lens are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Wonderful movement by Auxerre. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' 1 - 2 M'Bala Nzola (Lens) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
44' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is penalised for holding. Jeremy Stinat signals a set piece.
41' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Angelo Fulgini (Lens). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

41' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.

38' Kevin Danso (Lens) finds space near the penalty spot to plant a header at goal from the corner, but it's badly directed and drifts well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
38' The referee awards a corner and Angelo Fulgini (Lens) goes over to take it.

38' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Lens have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
35' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) makes a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Lens.
34' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
31' 1 - 1 Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) perfectly hits the free kick from just outside the box, sending the ball into the top left corner. Football fans are always happy to see such a fabulous goal.
30' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Auxerre are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
29' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Auxerre will take a throw-in.
27' The ball is cleared after Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
24' Auxerre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

24' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Brice Samba easily makes the save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Auxerre.
22' 0 - 1 Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
21' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
20' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

17' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
15' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
14' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) picks up an injury.
12' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) commits a rough foul. Jeremy Stinat stops the game and makes a call.
11' Auxerre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
10' Kevin Danso (Lens) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
7' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

6' A pass travels right across the box to M'Bala Nzola (Lens) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Donovan Leon denies him with a decent save. Now Lens have a corner.
6' Lens are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
3' Anass Zaroury (Lens) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Lens will have a throw-in.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lens are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lens will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will referee today's match.
